subsystems.name: Reasoning engine
subsystems.role: the language model that interprets goals, plans steps, and decides which tool to call next.

subsystems.name: Orchestrator
subsystems.role: manages the loop of plan, act, observe, and reflect until the task is complete.

subsystems.name: Tool layer
subsystems.role: connects the agent to external systems it can read from or act on.

subsystems.name: Memory and state
subsystems.role: remembers past steps, user context, and learned facts across sessions.

subsystems.name: Guardrails and observability
subsystems.role: keeps the agent safe, auditable, and within policy.

subsystems.name: Workflow interface
subsystems.role: where people define processes, review results, and intervene.

buildSteps.title: Map the process
buildSteps.detail: Identify a repetitive, multi-step business workflow and break it into discrete, verifiable steps with clear success criteria.

buildSteps.title: Choose and configure the model
buildSteps.detail: Select an LLM with strong reasoning and tool-use ability; write prompts that define the agent's role, constraints, and available actions.

buildSteps.title: Integrate tools
buildSteps.detail: Build connectors to the APIs, databases, and applications the agent needs; wrap each as a callable function the model can invoke.

buildSteps.title: Implement the agent loop
buildSteps.detail: Code the cycle of planning, acting via tools, observing results, and self-correcting when errors or unexpected outputs occur.

buildSteps.title: Add memory
buildSteps.detail: Set up a vector store and session state so the agent can recall context, remember past interactions, and avoid repeating mistakes.

buildSteps.title: Insert guardrails
buildSteps.detail: Add filters, rate limits, and approval gates for high-risk actions; log every step so the process can be audited and debugged.

buildSteps.title: Test and iterate
buildSteps.detail: Run the agent on historical cases, measure success and failure modes, and refine prompts, tools, and fallback strategies.

buildSteps.title: Deploy with human oversight
buildSteps.detail: Start with human review of outputs, then gradually increase autonomy as reliability and trust improve.

prerequisites.tech: Large language models with tool-use (function calling)
prerequisites.why: they provide the reasoning and the ability to invoke external APIs reliably enough for multi-step tasks.
they give agents long-term memory and access to private knowledge without retraining.

prerequisites.tech: Standardised API connectors and automation platforms
prerequisites.why: they let agents act on real systems like CRM, email, and databases in a controlled way.

prerequisites.tech: Reliable evaluation and safety frameworks for agents
prerequisites.why: without them, autonomous multi-step actions can fail silently or cause harm, limiting deployment to low-risk tasks.
most businesses still require approvals for critical steps, so seamless integration of human review is essential.

pathway.milestone: single-agent automation for structured tasks such as invoice processing or ticket triage
pathway.unlocks: time savings on repetitive, low-risk work with human review.

pathway.milestone: multi-agent systems that coordinate on long workflows with built-in error recovery
pathway.unlocks: automation of complex processes like supply-chain exception handling.

pathway.milestone: agents that learn from feedback and improve their own plans
autonomous enterprise processes with minimal human oversight
pathway.unlocks: end-to-end automation of back-office and customer operations.
